# Feature: Saga Workspace Phase 2 — Permissions, Reveal, Lore

Roadmap: Design `saga-workspace-ux-permissions` Phase 2 — catalog keys, bundles, Settings Rechte, binding reveal, Lore/Verlauf.

## Intent

Register `saga.*` permission keys and GM/Player bundles; let GMs assign bundles in Settings → Rechte; persist reveal on saga asset bindings (`gm_only` | `party` | `unlisted`) with RLS; flesh Lore/Verlauf with recaps + knowledge timeline.

## Preconditions

- Migrations through `075_saga_permission_grants.sql` applied
- User is active project member (or GM) of a saga
- Phase 1 workspace nav/shells present

## Happy Path

- [ ] Migration seeds keys + `bundle.saga.gm` / `bundle.saga.player` idempotently
- [ ] Settings → Rechte lists members and can assign Spielleitung / Spieler when `set_bundle` held
- [ ] Binding reveal control persists and list RPC hides `gm_only` from players without `*_hidden`
- [ ] Lore / Verlauf shows timeline entries or German empty state (not dead placeholder only)
- [ ] Phase-1 catalog shells still render

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Cannot revoke last `saga.members.set_bundle` holder
- [ ] `unlisted` bindings omitted from list RPC
- [ ] Non-member / missing lore.read: RPC fails closed

## Regression

- [ ] Visual style settings still load under Einstellungen
- [ ] Overview / lobby from Phase 1 unchanged

- Dornhain full seed + Welt maps fill = Phase 3 (#618)
- Project GM still treated as full grant bridge via `is_project_gm`
